references.text: The sons of Merari are mentioned as one of the three Levitical clans, which forms the basis for distributing cities to them.
Here is the command that the Levites should receive cities from the inheritance of the other tribes, which is fulfilled in Joshua 21.
This text provides the detailed list of the twelve cities that the sons of Merari received from Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
A parallel passage confirming that the sons of Merari were assigned cities from the tribes' inheritance.
The clan of Merari is mentioned with the number of cities they received, corresponding to the twelve cities listed in Joshua 21:7.
Detailed list of the cities given to the sons of Merari from Zebulun, Reuben, and Gad.
